requirements.text: Streamline the appointment process for both customers and staff.
Reduce no-shows through automated reminders sent 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments.
Enable 24/7 online booking for customers.
Allow each barber to manage their own schedules to reflect their availability accurately, preventing double bookings.
Provide clear visibility of bookings, cancellations, and peak times to aid decision-making for the barbershop.
Automated reminders should be sent via both SMS and email.
Reminders should be scheduled to go out 24 hours before and 1 hour before the appointment.
Each reminder should include an option for customers to confirm, cancel, or reschedule their appointment directly from the message.
The online booking interface should be user-friendly and straightforward.
Customers should be able to see the services offered, choose their preferred barber, and select an available time slot.
Required information from customers when making a booking includes their name, contact number, email address, and any specific requests or preferences in a notes section.
A calendar view should display available times to facilitate easy selection of appointments.
The booking system should show the duration and cost of each service upfront.
After booking, customers should receive a confirmation page with all appointment details, along with immediate confirmation sent via SMS and email.
Each barber should have their own login to the system to manage their schedules independently.
Barbers should be able to set their availability easily using a calendar interface.
The system should allow for quick updates in case of sudden changes, enabling barbers to block off time slots immediately from their phone or computer.
Barbers should be able to set recurring schedules for regular workdays.
A summary view should be available for barbers to see their upcoming appointments, cancellations, and customer requests.
A dashboard that provides a quick snapshot of daily appointments, including total bookings, cancellations, and no-shows.
A similar summary for weekly performance to identify trends in busyness across different days.
Metrics to track the number of appointments handled by each barber to monitor workload distribution.
The ability to identify patterns in cancellations and no-shows, particularly for frequent offenders.
Insights into peak times for appointments to inform staffing decisions.
All data should be consolidated in one place to facilitate day-to-day operations and long-term planning.
